_comment: Placeable tiles. Each entry also registers an item with the same id (category placeable_block). layer: blocks (solid, collision) | back (cosmetic wall) | climb (rope/ladder). atlas_row indexes assets/tiles/placeholder_blocks.png. hp/hardness apply to player-placed blocks only (WS-22); structure is unbreakable (GL-01). hardness = minimum tool tier to break.

blocks.desc: Sturdier metal block for hulls and airlocks.
